item.title: Deepak Hooda in list of bowlers with suspect bowling action, BCCI tells franchises before IPL 2026 auction- Report
item.description: Deepak Hooda is still on the list of bowlers who have questionable bowling actions. As he did during the previous IPL season, the 30-year-old all-rounder, who presently plays for Rajasthan, remains under the suspect bowling action category. Ahead of the IPL 2025 auction on December 16, the Board of Control for Cricket in India (BCCI) informed the IPL teams of its stance about Deepak Hooda's bowling action on Saturday, December 13, cricbuzz reported. item.title: IPL 2026: Jonny Bairstow high-value target- Sanjay Bangar; MSK Prasad says SRH or CSK might go for Ravi Bishnoi
item.description: Former India cricketer and batting instructor Sanjay Bangar believes England's hard-hitting batter Jonny Bairstow will be a popular choice for clubs searching for a top-order wicketkeeper-batter ahead of the IPL 2026 mini auction. Bangar emphasized Bairstow's appeal as a versatile option, stressing his ability to keep wickets and produce powerful starts at the top of the order. item.title: IND v SA 2025: “Gone back home…,” BCCI reveals reason for Jasprit Bumrah’s non-participation in third T20I
item.description: India’s playing XI for the ongoing third T20I against South Africa in Dharamsala left the fans surprised as pace spearhead Jasprit Bumrah did not feature in it. Speaking at the toss, India skipper Suryakumar Yadav revealed that Bumrah had gone back home due to personal reasons. Later, the BCCI confirmed through a social media that Bumrah's participation in the remaining two games of the T20I series will be provided in due course. item.description: Pakistan batter Babar Azam made a forgettable BBL debut for Sydney Sixers on Sunday (December 14), scoring just two runs off five balls before being dismissed by Perth Scorchers pacer Brody Couch. item.title: IND v SA 2025: “Not out of form, but definitely out of runs,” says Suryakumar Yadav after another failure in 3rd T20I
item.description: While Suryakumar Yadav has managed to produce impressive results as India’s T20I captain, his batting numbers have fallen drastically ever since assuming the leadership role. Suryakumar’s form in 2025 has been far from convincing. He has managed to score only 213 runs across 20 matches and 18 innings, averaging just over 14, with the best score of 47* to his credit. item.title: IND v SA 2025: Arshdeep Singh reflects on his match-winning 3rd T20I spell; dedicates POTM award to 10-month-old niece
item.description: After being taken to the cleaners in second T20I in Chandigarh, Arshdeep Singh bounced back brilliantly to script India’s seven-wicket victory over South Africa in third T20I in Dharamsala on Sunday (December 14). The left-arm seamer returned with the figures of 2 for 13 in his four overs, helping the hosts restrict the Proteas to a paltry 117/10 in 20 overs. item.title: IND v SA 2025: “It feels really good,” Varun Chakaravarthy on becoming second fastest Indian bowler to claim 50 T20I wickets
item.description: On a Dharamsala pitch assisting the seam bowlers, India’s mystery spinner Varun Chakaravarthy shone through again in the third T20I against South Africa on Sunday (December 14). Varun returned with the figures of 2 for 11 in four overs, helping the hosts bundle out the Proteas for a below-par 117 in 20 overs.
